scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @nivasa/backend" "npm run dev -w @nivasa/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nivasa/shared && npm run build -w @nivasa/backend && npm run build -w @nivasa/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nivasa/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nivasa/backend && npm run typecheck -w @nivasa/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nivasa/shared && npm run test -w @nivasa/backend && npm run test -w @nivasa/frontend
